title: Understanding MSE on Test Data
text: When you add a new feature to a model, especially one that is a transformation of an existing feature, it can affect the model's ability to generalize to new data. Think about how adding complexity might impact the model's performance on unseen data.

title: Impact of Feature Addition
text: Consider how adding a feature that is a transformation of an existing one might change the model's flexibility. Does it make the model more adaptable to the training data, or does it risk overfitting?

title: Evaluating MSE Changes
